title: ReproCheck 0.17 cross-domain source-unseen holdout
research_question: How accurately does the frozen ReproCheck 0.17 evaluator recover declared numerical model-evaluation claims in unseen repositories and formats?

selection.deterministic_order: ascending SHA-256 of repository name, pinned commit, and relative path
selection.insufficient_pool_rule: include every eligible file and report the shortfall without replacement from another pool

primary_endpoints.claim_level_precision: exact normalized metric, value, and declared context match
primary_endpoints.claim_level_recall: exact normalized metric, value, and declared context match
primary_endpoints.artifact_level_exact_match: all and only in-scope claims recovered for a complete file

stopping_rule: One evaluator run after source fetch, dual annotation freeze, adjudication, and gold lock; no parser modification before the primary result is sealed.

analysis_plan.intervals: Wilson 95% intervals for precision and recall
analysis_plan.agreement: claim-presence Cohen's kappa plus exact artifact agreement
analysis_plan.failure_analysis: post-hoc and labeled separately from the immutable primary score

scientific_boundary: This protocol tests extraction generalization and annotation reliability, not the scientific truth or reproducibility of the source projects. Repository commits were resolved before registration; source file contents must not be inspected until the evaluator and this protocol are hashed together.
